notes: There are 23 endpoints. 21 are new routes from system-design §3.3. 2 are existing routes that get extended: PATCH /api/users/:id (isSafeguardingLead, FR-2) and POST /api/internal/email/dispatch (processPendingMessageEmails, FR-20). The file routes gain the 'message' context with no contract change (FR-27).

The base path is /api, not /api/v1. Envelopes and error codes come from src/server/http.ts. VALIDATION_ERROR maps to 400, not 422, so the 422 mentioned for isSafeguardingLead in system-design §1 should be read as 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

Error policy: a non-participant or a participant who has left gets 404. Contact rules, relationship ended, the edit window and safeguarding access give 403 with details.reason. A duplicate OPEN report or reviewing a non-OPEN report gives 409. The rate limit gives 429 with details.retryAfterMs.

Decisions made beyond system-design: leave refusals use details.reason 'ONE_TO_ONE' or 'CREATOR_OF_STUDENT_GROUP'. A review requires a note; a dismissal does not. Safeguarding GET /conversations/:id returns 404 when involvesStudent is false. The message poll returns hasMore only in initial and 'before' mode. The dispatch summary gains messageEmails {sent, deferred, dropped}.
Carried risks from system-design §1: there is no user-admin UI for isSafeguardingLead; mui-mcp must be used in dev (NFR-5); the rate limiter is per-process; students/[id] needs a new layout.tsx.
src/lib/validators/messaging.ts should mirror the DTOs in api-contracts.json `components`.
